title: This Earth a Temporary Inn (Pyrthei Shong Basa)
cultural_context: Published historical Khasi song from authentic literature, documenting ancestral culture, moral philosophy, and oral tradition.
lyrics_khasi:
Kane ka pyrthei ka long tang ka shong basa,
Ngim ju sah junom ha kane ka jaka;
Ngi wan kum ki nongleit nongwan ba iaid lynti,
Ban kamai ia ka hok shuwa ban leit phai.

To kynmaw ia ka akor bad ka burom,
To leh bha ia uba duk bad uba dukhi;
Namar haba la khot u Blei ia ka mynsiem,
Tang ka hok kaba lah ban leit ryngkat.
lyrics_english:
This world is but a temporary resting inn,
We abide not forever in this mortal realm;
We arrive as wayfarers traveling on our journey,
To earn righteousness before returning home.

Remember therefore virtue and noble manners,
Act kindly toward the poor and the afflicted;
For when God summons the spirit to depart,
Righteousness alone shall accompany the soul.
